note.value: Undead fleets must purchase one of three different Admirals: a Liche, a Necromancer, or a Tomb King.

Undead fleets purchase crew separately and crew ships from those purchased. Each Admiral grants a certain number of crew points per 500 fleet points.

1 pt: (Z) Zombie, -1 CC if leading
2 pts: (S) Skeleton, +0 CC if leading
3 pts: (W) Wight, +1 CC if leading

The ship cards Crew Track is the maximum number of crew the ship can hold.
Undead has access to Necromatic or Color magic. When using a Color wizard, the wizard is still a Necromatic wizard (as such it gains no college benefits).
If an undead fleet, commanded by either a Liche or Necromancer, loses it's Admiral, roll for d6 BtW hits for each Ship of the Line, no saves. Losing a Tomb King, or his Wizard, has no such effect.
